assessment: The principal full-library packet completed the atomic serial and opaque equality-formula targets. In those same contexts, the atom-name full library supplied a local one-step certificate but no whole-target packet. Both full libraries completed the constructor-preserving calibration. Neither abstraction completed the mismatched target; its separately authored finite valuation satisfies all hypotheses and falsifies that conclusion.

All sixteen pools exhausted their declared finite source-occurrence enumeration within the fixed caps. There were three paired inventory entries and two principal structural shapes; no entries were coalesced. Four selected recipient witnesses certified whole target regions, while twelve certified only their own local results.

This is a bounded packet-availability experiment. The donor proofs were searched; recipient proofs were obtained by the declared finite receptor-binding enumeration, not by a recipient GCTS or RL search.
The full and one-step views retain the generic MP packet. Availability of a multi-step packet measures reusable packaging; the same consequence can still be reached by composing primitive steps.

The type argument applies to a fixed finite MP graph and its explicit port sharing. Finite controls and independent inferencer agreement support this implementation; they do not constitute a mechanized general proof.

No new RL training, matched search speedup, broad benchmark superiority, or physical universal Wang qualification is claimed. The previous learned-selector comparison did not show an RL-specific gain.
cost_prose: All acquisition, dual abstraction, independent verification, context compilation, binding, witness checking, serialization and process custody belong to this one cold actual. No earlier proof, library or policy was adopted.
Observer elapsed sample: 33.383 s; final observer gate: 33.384 s. These are recorded observer samples, not exact tool end-to-end clocks.

Conservative whole memory bound: 335.12 MiB. The actual started 70 Native queries and retained 70 complete records. Selected recipient witness occurrences: 16; whole-target certificate occurrences: 4. Repeated occurrences are not distinct new theorems.

The full query stream includes compiler candidate probes: 32 requests accepted and 38 rejected. All required donor, fragment and selected recipient certificates were accepted. The listed finite control banks report 202 passed controls.

Original ceilings: 160 s work, 180 s positive completion, 210 s custody, 225 s external fallback; 1 GiB whole memory, 128 MiB physical output, 512 Native starts and one billion Native steps per request. Pool cap: 16 packets and 20,000 validation checks per cell.

The original and corrected reference verifiers both audited each of the six fresh models. This small corpus does not establish that the previously failing quantified setup now fits, and no verifier speed comparison was run.

observer_receipt.watchdog_scope: Separate process with225second fallback trigger and bounded cleanup; not an OS real-time guarantee or adversarial sandbox.
